summary: Iteration 49 — Non-regression sweep after the user emptied a Supabase Studio SQL snippet 'Row-Level Security for Sales Access'. GREP confirmed 0 references to the 'sales' table anywhere in /app/backend or /app/frontend, so nothing app-side depends on it. Ran a targeted regression test suite covering every critical Plume Astrale flow: 10/10 backend pytest cases PASS (health, astrocarto cities/search, astrocarto checkout Stripe LIVE, astrocarto checkout PLUME15 (-15%), astrocarto status 404 on unknown, astrocarto checkout 400 on wrong-cities-count, tarot/oui-non enrichi, oracle enrichi, astrosexo/personal enrichi with Vénus/Mars/Lune, compatibility/generate PDF base64 magic %PDF-1). One flaky 502 (Cloudflare) on the first astrosexo run — retested in isolation and PASS in 2.15s. Frontend Playwright smoke: homepage / renders with 'Soléna' hero text, /astrocartographie exposes data-testid='astrocartographie-page', /outils/astrosexo exposes data-testid='astrosexo-page' AND after clicking the first sign the block data-testid='astrosexo-perso-block' becomes visible. Zero console errors on the tested pages. CONCLUSION: no regression whatsoever from the SQL Studio snippet incident.

minor.issue: One transient Cloudflare 502 during a heavy back-to-back test batch. Direct curl afterwards responds 200 in 3.8s. Root cause is upstream infrastructure (edge cluster preview-11), not the app. Retest in isolation PASSES.

Log warning: 'Unexpected error retrieving session status: 1 validation error for CheckoutStatusResponse - dict_type' — the CheckoutStatusResponse pydantic model in emergentintegrations expects a dict for one field but receives another type when Stripe API returns for a real cs_live session. Non-blocking (task runs in background) but pollutes logs. Should be surfaced to emergentintegrations maintainers or wrapped in try/except at the caller.

flow_verdict.astrocarto_checkout_PLUME15_discount: PASS — session created, status endpoint returns row (discount_percent=15 in metadata)
flow_verdict.tarot_oui_non_enrichi: PASS — reponse_enrichie:true, text >500 chars, ends with '?'
flow_verdict.oracle_enrichi: PASS — enrichi:true, answer >500 chars, ends with '?'
flow_verdict.astrosexo_personal_enrichi: PASS — enrichi:true + venus_sign/mars_sign/moon_sign + analysis >2000 chars (Vénus Bélier, Mars Poissons, Lune Capricorne)
flow_verdict.frontend_astrosexo_perso_block_after_sig: PASS — 12 signs found, clicking sign-0 (Bélier) makes astrosexo-perso-block visible with CTA 'CRÉER MON COMPTE GRATUIT'

action_items: None required — the SQL snippet incident had ZERO impact on the app. The 'sales' table isn't referenced anywhere in the Plume Astrale codebase (grep confirmed).

OPTIONAL — Wrap services/self_heal.py CheckoutStatusResponse parsing in a try/except to silence the recurring 'dict_type' pydantic warning when Stripe returns unusual payload shapes for cs_live_* sessions.

OPTIONAL — Add retries with backoff around the /api/astrosexo/personal call chain (natal_chart + love_languages + personality_analysis + enrich_and_ask make 3-4 external API calls sequentially — a Cloudflare 502 can hit at any point). Not urgent since single-call latency is fine (~3.8s).
critical_code_review_comments: Confirmed: 0 references to 'sales' in /app/backend/**/*.py and /app/frontend/**/*.js — the user's fear was unfounded, only a saved SQL editor snippet was emptied, no DROP/DELETE was executed against the database.

routes/astrocartographie.py:143 uses try_consume_promo(promo) inside the same block that also handles PLUME15 — the code correctly separates PLUME15 (partial discount 15%) from admin-bypass promos (full free via promo_codes table). Clean design.
server.py:1780 /api/oracle and server.py:1828 /api/tarot/oui-non both wrap enrich_and_ask in try/except so a GPT call failure gracefully degrades to the base reading. Good defensive coding.
routes/astrosexo.py:99 calls enrich_and_ask WITHOUT a try/except — if GPT is down the endpoint bubbles a 500. Consider wrapping it in try/except like the other enriched endpoints. Not blocking today.
server.py:1272 /api/compatibility/generate correctly returns a data:application/pdf;base64,... URL — no MongoDB _id leakage, no session-side effects, response fully synchronous. LGTM.

success_rate.backend: 100% (10/10 pytest — 9/10 on the first pass with 1 transient 502 on astrosexo, then 10/10 after retry)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (4/4 smoke checks — homepage Soléna hero, /astrocartographie testid, /outils/astrosexo testid, perso-block visible after sign click)

rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bug to fix. The user emptied a saved SQL snippet in Supabase Studio's SQL Editor sidebar; snippets are UI-only saved queries and have zero effect on the underlying database schema. The 'sales' table + its RLS policy 'sales_select_own' still exist in the DB (unchanged) and are not touched by any Plume Astrale code path (grep = 0). Full-regression run confirms 100% of critical flows still work.
